difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is that flat pullback preserves rational equivalence at source lines 2133-2139, label lemma-flat-pullback-rational-equivalence, whose proof occupies source lines 2141-2173. The proof unwinds rational equivalence into a locally finite sum of pushforwards of divisors of rational functions, observes that the pulled back sum is well defined because the preimages of the subspaces stay locally finite, passes to the fibre products over those subspaces and moves the flat pullback inside the sum by the projection formula, and then applies the preparation formula term by term to see that each pulled back divisor is rationally equivalent to zero. Local finiteness is what upgrades the term by term conclusion to the statement. The counted statement records neither the fibre products nor the term by term reduction.
